text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Trainer <username>,

Thank you for your hard work. Here is my daily report for today."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Health status: 37.8°C (normal), no body pain.
Meals: Attached records for 3 meals + 1 snack."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: “Voluntary Training Report: None”

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"That is all. Please review it.

—Air Messiah"

"Air Messiah,

Thank you for the daily report. Acknowledged."

"I finish typing, 'I look forward to continuing to work with you,'
and reach for the mouse, only to hesitate for a moment."
Then, I add just one more line.
choice_data_list: "We arrive a day early tomorrow. Please get plenty of rest."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(......"Understood.
Thank you very much for your consideration"—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, hello? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
""Ah, hello, Meji-chan?!
Don't 'what's the matter' me~~~!""

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
""You're heading to Kyoto tomorrow, right?
And then the day after is your Make Debut, yeah!?""

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Aah, no way~! I'm so nervoooous!
Hey, are you okay, Met-chan? Think you can sleep!?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm quite alright, but...
You're not the one running, so there's no need to make such a fuss.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister & ???
text_block_list.text: "No waaaaay!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
""Ah, that voice! Vib-chi!
Hey, it's Vib-chi, right? Long time no see~!""

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yay, it's Viblos-chi☆
Me-chan Senpai, I'm home too~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—No, wait!
C'mon, Senpai, that's not it at all!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I have an older sister too, so I totally get it!
You get nervous, you worry, and you end up making a fuss!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Because it's about my super, super precious big sister!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister & Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Right~~~♡"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, alright, I understand.
Let's stop making a racket in stereo. It's night, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Still... you're cheering for me, aren't you?
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I'll give it my all. ...Well then, see you later.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~. They get along so well,
Meji-senpai and the others!
Well, not as well as me and my big sisters, though~

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not competing with you.
...More importantly, Vivlos?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I believe I have mentioned this several times, but 'Me-chan' is a nickname given to me by my siblings...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It's a little embarrassing, so I'd appreciate
it if you didn't adopt that too often.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー! But, but, you're just so cute!
We're roommates, so it's fine, right~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, never mind that, what about your debut race!
It's the day after tomorrow, right? Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'm rootin' for you, Me-chan senpaaai♡

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
......Umm.
Thank you for cheering for me.

"And now.
The day of the Make Debut has finally arrived—!"
choice_data_list: Well then... let's head into the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ? Um, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: The waiting room is next door.

"...Recalling my blunder from earlier, I cover my face.
To openly display such nervousness in front of the Umamusume I train right before a major race
is truly unbecoming of a trainer."
choice_data_list: (No, no, no! I have to calm down!)

text_block_list.text: However, telling myself "I'm nervous, so I should stop being nervous" naturally had no effect... I could feel a nasty, cold sweat slowly trickling down my back.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting, Trainer.
I'm all changed—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
Are you feeling nervous?

Thinking it would be cruel to confess outright,
I instinctively shook my head. ...And then—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
...I suppose I really am nervous.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I'm not fearless enough to declare that I'm "totally fine."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ordinary, modest. Right before the big moment—I get nervous.
choice_data_list: Even though... it looks so stable...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Is it because she thinks
it's "only natural"?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. ...My mother taught me
a relaxation method.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: If you don't mind, would you carry this out with me?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Well then.
Please stay by my side just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: And then—reach out a hand.

Following Air Messiah's lead, I place my hands against hers.
From our fingertips lightly touching, I feel warmth.
Her hands are faintly warm...
choice_data_list: (No, maybe my hands are just... really cold)
(No, it's just... my hands are really cold)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Close your eyes. Follow my lead...
Let's take slow, deep breaths. Breathe in... and out.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"And then, please picture it in your mind.
Fire. ...A small flame, for now."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Breathe in... and out.
Breathe in... and out.
The oxygen will slowly make the flame grow larger.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Breathe in... and out.
Breathe in... and out.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
From spark to fire. And into a roaring blaze.
Breathe in—and breathe out.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Breathe in--

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Stop it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Fufu. ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Our hands have gotten completely warm now, haven't they?
—Both of ours.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your cooperation.
Shall we... get going soon, then?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It may be a cliché, as always.
—I shall return victorious.
